t: Quarto Acquires Cool Springs Press
s: March 2, 2011 - Quarto Group announced Tuesday that the U.K-based company has acquired Cool Springs Press, headquartered in Brentwood, Tenn. Cool Springs Press will become an imprint of Quayside Publishing Group, Quarto Group’s American subsidiary, headquartered in Minneapolis.
